description: This file contains test cases for a test project configuration and invocation logic, including functions to build Vitest args, route test targets to specific configuration files, and handle test suite specifications. It demonstrates usage of testing libraries and dynamic imports to test the build logic.

methods.name: buildVitestArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for Vitest based on input parameters, handling default modes and specific flags.

methods.name: buildVitestRunPlans
methods.description: Routes test file paths to specific Vitest configuration files based on patterns and rules, supporting extended test suites, helper files, and extensions.

methods.name: createVitestRunSpecs
methods.description: Generates detailed test run specifications, including scoped include files and environment setup, for routed test files.

methods.name: parseTestProjectsArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments related to test projects, distinguishing between forwarded arguments, target arguments, and watch mode status.
